caption: Il Vittoriale degli Italiani, Gardone Riviera
composition: D'Annunzio hillside estate with amphitheatre terraces overlooking Lake Garda · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From above the estate, the tourist looks across the amphitheatre's curved stone terraces center-frame toward Lake Garda stretching right to the hazy mountains. The villa stands at the left among towering dark cypresses, with broad stairs descending past it to the arena. The 11:40 sun is bright and high under a clear blue sky, and the lake glitters pale blue beyond the green slopes.
